findings.current: That blinding streak of light, with power no one could believe came from an arrow, had appeared from nowhere.
findings.defect: The draft says the streak appeared from nowhere; the source says it had been nowhere to be seen a moment earlier.
findings.rationale: The leaders are puzzled because the visible streak was absent just before the commander fell.
findings.replacement: That terrifying streak of light, too powerful to seem like an arrow, had been nowhere to be seen a moment ago.
findings.source: 도무지 화살이라고는 믿을 수 없는, 무시무시한 위력을 지닌 빛줄기는 조금 전 어디에서도 찾아볼 수 없었으니까.

findings.current: They were powerful figures who had pledged their loyalty to Dark Heaven and the Eastern Heaven Demon Lord, powerful enough to pass their positions down to their heirs.
findings.defect: The draft turns the generational depth of their allegiance into an assertion that their positions were hereditary.
findings.rationale: 대를 이을 만큼 qualifies the enduring commitment to Dark Heaven and the Demon Lord; the passage does not say these figures could bequeath their offices.
findings.replacement: They were powerful figures whose families had pledged loyalty to Dark Heaven and the Eastern Heaven Demon Lord for generations.
findings.source: 하나같이 화려한 복장을 한 그들은 이미 대(代)를 이을 만큼 암천과 동천마군에게 충성을 맹세한 거물들이었고, 두 번 다시 돌아올 수 없는 강을 건넌 이들이었으니까.

findings.current: instead of suffering horribly under cruel torture before being torn limb from limb by the wheel
findings.defect: The execution method becomes breaking on the wheel rather than dismemberment by carts.
findings.rationale: 거열형 is an execution in which carts pull the condemned person's limbs apart; no wheel is specified.
findings.replacement: instead of suffering through brutal torture before being torn limb from limb by carts
findings.source: 모진 고문으로 끔찍하게 고통받다가 거열형(車裂刑)에 사지가 찢겨 나가는 대신

findings.current: The wet, meaty sounds announcing the end of the banquet—once soaked in blood—mixed with the ceaseless screams of the wounded, like a powerful drumbeat.
findings.defect: The draft removes the actual drums, making the screams sound like a drumbeat instead of having both the screams and sounds of pierced flesh mingle with it.
findings.rationale: The source has three concurrent sounds: pierced flesh, screams, and drums that keep ringing.
findings.replacement: The sounds of flesh being pierced announced the end of the blood-soaked banquet. Screams of pain joined them, mingling with the powerful, unceasing beat of drums.
findings.source: 피로 물들었던 연회의 끝을 알리는 파육음이, 고통에 찬 비명이 쉬지 않고 울려 퍼지는 힘찬 북소리와 뒤섞였다.

findings.current: A blade-sharp energy rose from her entire body.
findings.defect: The draft assigns the rising energy to So Gyo instead of the first-person narrator.
findings.rationale: Taekyung is watching her approach with a cold gaze; So Gyo then stops and looks at him. The unmarked body in this first-person narration is his.
findings.replacement: Blade-sharp qi rose from every part of my body.
findings.source:
스아아아.

칼날과도 같은 기운이 전신에서 솟아오른다. 몇 걸음 앞에서 멈춰선 궁성이 말없이 나를 바라보다, 불현듯 입을 열었다.

summary: Five actionable fidelity findings, including an altered observation, a changed execution method, and a reversed subject.
